messages:
Pranav: quick q — if a tenant hits their notify quota and a threshold fires, does the console show the alert as suppressed or still show an active alert with a note about quota?
Anya: it shows active but annotated as "suppressed by quota" in the UI. backend still emits the signal.
Kevin: to add, we only suppress fanout; the SLO card keeps the breach visible so oncall sees the impact.
Pranav: ok that makes sense. curious about sampling: when quota kicks in, are we doing uniform sampling across signals or preferring high-severity ones? :thinking:
devops-bot: FYI deployment 2024-11-05/notify-v3 rolled; sampling logic changed to severity-weighted. link: https://deploys/internal/notify-v3
Anya: severity-weighted yes — critical alerts get higher sample_rate. non-critical go down to floor 0.01 by default.
Sam: small nit — the console label "suppressed by quota" is buried in the overflow. can we add a pill on the SLO card? customers keep asking why they see no page.
Maria: +1. UX should show both: a red breach indicator and a yellow quarantine pill with hover explaining sampling.
Kevin: implementation note: adding pill is cheap in frontend but we need to expose the sampling metadata from notify API. current API returns header X-Notify-Sample: "rate=0.02,reason=quota" but we don't surface that down the chain.
Pranav: can we standardize on a field in the alert payload? sample_metadata:{rate,reason,policy} — easier for console.
Anya: agreed. PR incoming to notify API to add sample_metadata. also adding a tiny telemetry flag so we can graph how many breaches were only sampled.
Sam: example payload sketch that would help frontend work: 
```
{
  "slo_id": "svc-123",
  "breach": true,
  "sample_metadata": {"rate": "0.02", "reason": "quota", "policy": "tiered-fanout"}
}
```
Maria: also: we should include a fallback routing hint when an alert is sampled out — e.g., "suggest fallback to email or backlog" — helps SRE decide next steps.
Kevin: caveat: adding more fields bloats telemetry. we should gate with a feature flag and scrub PII.
Anya: agreed on flag and scrub. plan: backend PR, api contract change, frontend pill, rollout behind flag. canary to tenants with high-noise SLOs first.
Pranav: timeline? can we get a small spike this week to prove the API shape?
Anya: i'll open PR today, Kevin will review, Sam can prototype pill in a branch. aim for canary next week.
Pranav: perfect. leaving a quick checklist: 1) API field 2) telemetry counter for sampled breaches 3) frontend pill + hover 4) canary config 5) docs update.
Sam: I'll add a tiny UX screenshot mock in the PR description.
devops-bot: NOTE: created ticket INF-4823 notify-api-sample-metadata - assigned to @Anya - due 2024-11-12
Pranav: thanks team :thumbsup:
